note: Comments of the tool-description templates in docs/context-injections (tool-description-template.*.jsonc), generated by prompt_profile::template. subagent.structured_output_nudge.zh: 绑定了输出 schema 的子代理一轮结束仍未调用 `structured_output` 时，一次性给它的提醒。

subagent.structured_output_settled.en: Tool result of a valid `structured_output` call.

max_attempts.en: the maximum number of attempts allowed

subagent.missing_structured_output.zh: 绑定输出 schema 的子代理始终未调用 `structured_output` 时，放在其最终文本前的提示。

subagent.failed.en: Result text (or suffix) used when a child agent's model request failed.
subagent.failed.zh: 子代理的模型请求失败时，作为结果正文（或后缀）的文字。

subagent.failed_unknown_reason.en: Failure reason used in the child agent failure text when Mewrk has no more specific reason.
subagent.failed_unknown_reason.zh: Mewrk 没有更具体的原因时，写入子代理失败文字中的原因。

subagent.no_text_result.en: Result text used when a child agent finished its run without returning any text.
subagent.no_text_result.zh: 子代理运行结束却没有返回任何文本时，作为结果正文的文字。

subagent.result_truncated.en: Suffix appended when a child agent's final text was cut to the output limit.
subagent.result_truncated.zh: 子代理的最终文本因超出输出上限被截断时追加的后缀。

subagent.forced_stop.en: Result text used when Mewrk force-stopped a child agent that ignored a stop request.
subagent.forced_stop.zh: 子代理无视停止请求而被 Mewrk 强制停止时，作为结果正文的文字。

subagent.worker_panic.en: Result text used when a task worker crashed with an internal error.
subagent.worker_panic.zh: 任务工作线程因内部错误崩溃时，作为结果正文的文字。

subagent.structured_result_block.en: Fenced block appended to a result that carries a structured result.
subagent.structured_result_block.zh: 追加在带有结构化结果的返回内容末尾的代码块。

body.en: the structured result as JSON text
body.zh: JSON 文本形式的结构化结果

subagent.structured_unserializable.en: Text shown in the structured result block when the value cannot be serialized.
subagent.structured_unserializable.zh: 结构化结果无法序列化时，显示在结构化结果代码块中的文字。

subagent.structured_truncated.en: Suffix inside the structured result block when the value was cut to the inline length limit.
subagent.structured_truncated.zh: 结构化结果超出内联长度上限被截断时，结果代码块内的后缀。

skill.tool_description.en: Description of the on-demand `skill` tool, which the model reads to decide when to load a skill.
skill.tool_description.zh: 按需加载技能的 `skill` 工具的描述，模型据此判断何时加载技能。

skill.name_description.en: Description of the `name` parameter of the `skill` tool.

skill.listing_heading.en: Heading of the skill trigger list in the system prompt.
skill.listing_heading.zh: 系统提示词中技能触发列表的标题。

skill.listing_row.en: One row of the skill trigger list in the system prompt.
skill.listing_row.zh: 系统提示词中技能触发列表的一行。

skill.listing_row_untriggered.en: One row of the skill list for a skill whose `SKILL.md` gives no description to use as its trigger.
skill.listing_row_untriggered.zh: 技能列表中的一行，用于 `SKILL.md` 没有可作触发描述的技能。

skill.result.en: Tool result of a successful `skill` call.
skill.result.zh: 成功调用 `skill` 工具后的工具结果。

tool_search.tool_description.en: Description of the `tool_search` tool, offered when MCP tool schemas are held back until the model loads them.
tool_search.tool_description.zh: `tool_search` 工具的描述；当 MCP 工具的参数定义被暂缓提供时，模型靠它按需加载。

tool_search.announcement.en: Context injected at the start of every step of a run that held back MCP tool schemas, listing the held-back tools.
tool_search.announcement.zh: 在暂缓提供 MCP 工具定义的运行中，每一步开头注入的上下文，列出这些暂缓的工具。

tools.en: the held-back tools, one row per MCP server
tools.zh: 暂缓的工具，每个 MCP 服务器一行

tool_search.announcement_row.en: One row of the held-back tool list: all tools declared by one MCP server.
tool_search.announcement_row.zh: 暂缓工具列表中的一行：同一个 MCP 服务器声明的全部工具。

names.en: the names of that server's tools

tool_search.result.en: Tool result of a `tool_search` call that matched at least one tool.
tool_search.result.zh: `tool_search` 调用匹配到工具时的工具结果。

functions.en: the schemas of the matched tools

tool_search.no_match.en: Tool result of a `tool_search` call that matched no tool.
tool_search.no_match.zh: `tool_search` 调用没有匹配到任何工具时的工具结果。

query.en: the query the model searched for

tool_search.not_loaded.en: Rejection returned when the model calls an MCP tool whose schema has not been loaded yet in this run.
tool_search.not_loaded.zh: 模型调用了本次运行中尚未加载定义的 MCP 工具时返回的拒绝提示。

role.listing_heading.en: Heading of the agent type list appended to the `agent_spawn` / `workflow` tool description.
role.listing_heading.zh: 追加在 `agent_spawn` / `workflow` 工具描述后的代理类型列表标题。

role.listing_row.en: One row of the agent type list appended to the `agent_spawn` / `workflow` tool description.
role.listing_row.zh: 追加在 `agent_spawn` / `workflow` 工具描述后的代理类型列表的一行。

task.wait_timeout_all_pending.en: Opening notice of a `task_wait` result that timed out before any of the awaited tasks finished.
task.wait_timeout_all_pending.zh: `task_wait` 超时且所等待的任务都尚未完成时，结果开头的提示。

max_seconds.en: the longest allowed wait in seconds

task.wait_timeout_partial.en: Opening notice of a `task_wait` result that timed out after some tasks' results were already delivered.
task.wait_timeout_partial.zh: `task_wait` 超时但已有部分任务交付结果时，结果开头的提示。

delivered.en: the tasks whose results are included

max_seconds.en: the longest allowed wait in seconds

task.wait_pending_fallback.en: Wording that stands in for the list of still-running tasks when the wait named no specific task.
task.wait_pending_fallback.zh: 等待未指定具体任务时，用来代替“仍在运行的任务”列表的措辞。

task.wait_idle.en: `task_wait` result when no task is running and no update is waiting to be collected.
task.wait_idle.zh: 没有运行中的任务、也没有待收取的更新时，`task_wait` 的结果。

task.progress_update_label.en: Status word in the header of a progress-update envelope, as in `[agent · progress update]`.
task.progress_update_label.zh: 进度更新信封标题中的状态词，如 `[agent · progress update]`。

task.no_text_result.en: Body of a result envelope whose task returned no text.
task.no_text_result.zh: 任务没有返回文本时，结果信封的正文。

task.cost_line.en: Footer line of each result envelope in a `task_wait` result, showing what the turn cost.
task.cost_line.zh: `task_wait` 结果中每个结果信封末尾的一行，显示该回合的消耗。

tokens.zh: 本回合消耗的 token 数

task.cost_unknown_tokens.en: Wording used for the token count when the provider reported no usage.
task.cost_unknown_tokens.zh: 模型服务商没有上报用量时，用来代替 token 数的措辞。

task.wait_delivered_on_call.en: Body of a `task_wait` section whose task's result already went to the asynchronous call that started it.
task.wait_delivered_on_call.zh: `task_wait` 某一段的正文：该任务的结果已作为启动它的异步调用的输出交付。

task.wait_status_heading.en: Heading of the status summary ending a `task_wait` result; the app's display recognizes the built-in English heading.
task.wait_status_heading.zh: `task_wait` 结果末尾状态汇总的标题；界面按内置英文标题识别它。

task.status.completed.en: Status word for a completed task.
task.status.completed.zh: 任务已完成时使用的状态词。

task.status.interrupted.en: Status word for an interrupted task.
task.status.interrupted.zh: 任务被中断时使用的状态词。

task.status.failed.en: Status word for a failed task.
task.status.failed.zh: 任务失败时使用的状态词。

task.status.stopped.en: Status word for a task that the user stopped.
task.status.stopped.zh: 用户已停止的任务的状态词。

task.status.round_limit.en: Status word for a task that hit its round limit.
task.status.round_limit.zh: 达到回合上限的任务的状态词。

task.status.running.en: Status word for a running task.

task.status.idle.en: Status word for a subagent that finished its turn and is waiting.
task.status.idle.zh: 已结束回合并在等待的子代理的状态词。

task.list_empty.en: Result of the `task_list` tool when the conversation has no tasks.
task.list_empty.zh: 对话中没有任务时，`task_list` 工具返回的结果。

task.list_total.en: First line of a non-empty `task_list` result.

task.list_row_label.en: Suffix on a `task_list` row (and a `task_wait` observation) showing the task's label.
task.list_row_label.zh: `task_list` 行（及 `task_wait` 观察结果）末尾的任务标签后缀。

task.list_latest_update.en: Line under a `task_list` row showing the task's latest progress update.
task.list_latest_update.zh: `task_list` 行下方显示任务最新进展的一行。

task.list_result_in_timeline.en: Suffix on the `task_list` status of a finished task whose result is already in the timeline.
task.list_result_in_timeline.zh: `task_list` 中已完成且结果已在时间线里的任务的状态后缀。

task.group.workflows.zh: `task_list` 中工作流运行分组的标题。

task.group.shell_commands.en: `task_list` group title for background shell commands.
task.group.shell_commands.zh: `task_list` 中后台 shell 命令分组的标题。

task.group.preview_servers.zh: `task_list` 中开发服务器分组的标题。

task.preview.starting.en: Status of a dev server that is still starting up.
task.preview.starting.zh: 仍在启动中的开发服务器的状态。

task.preview.running.en: Status of a dev server that is up and answering.
task.preview.running.zh: 已启动并在响应的开发服务器的状态。

task.preview.stopped.en: Status of a dev server that is no longer registered.
task.preview.stopped.zh: 已不再注册的开发服务器的状态。

task.terminal.running.en: Status of a terminal that has a command running.
task.terminal.running.zh: 正在运行命令的终端的状态。

task.terminal.exited.en: Status of a terminal whose shell has exited.
task.terminal.exited.zh: 其 shell 已退出的终端的状态。

task.shell.completed.en: Status of a background command that exited successfully.
task.shell.completed.zh: 成功退出的后台命令的状态。

task.shell.failed.en: Status of a background command that exited with an error.
task.shell.failed.zh: 以错误退出的后台命令的状态。

task.shell.aborted.en: Status of a background command that was aborted.
task.shell.aborted.zh: 已被中止的后台命令的状态。

task.shell.aborting.en: Status of a background command that is being aborted.
task.shell.aborting.zh: 正在被中止的后台命令的状态。

task.shell.running.en: Status of a running background command.
task.shell.running.zh: 运行中的后台命令的状态。

task.shell.finished.en: Status of a background command that finished without an exit code.
task.shell.finished.zh: 已结束但没有退出码的后台命令的状态。

task.shell_result.en: Body of the result delivered when a background shell command finishes.
task.shell_result.zh: 后台 shell 命令结束时所返回结果的正文。

tool_name.en: the name of the tool that ran the command

task.shell_exit_code.en: Exit-status wording in a finished background command's result when the exit code is known.
task.shell_exit_code.zh: 后台命令结果中退出码已知时的退出状态措辞。

task.shell_exit_unknown.en: Exit-status wording in a finished background command's result when the exit code is unknown.
task.shell_exit_unknown.zh: 后台命令结果中退出码未知时的退出状态措辞。

task.shell_no_output.en: Output wording in a finished background command's result when it printed nothing.
task.shell_no_output.zh: 后台命令结果中命令没有任何输出时的输出措辞。

task.shell_stopped_by_user.en: Result body of a background command the user stopped, including whatever it printed first.
task.shell_stopped_by_user.zh: 用户停止的后台命令的结果正文，附带它此前已输出的内容。

tool_name.en: the name of the tool that ran the command

body.en: the output printed before it stopped

task.shell_stopped_by_model.en: Result body of a background command the model stopped with `task_stop`, including its earlier output.
task.shell_stopped_by_model.zh: 模型用 `task_stop` 停止的后台命令的结果正文，附带此前已输出的内容。

tool_name.en: the name of the tool that ran the command

body.en: the output printed before it stopped

task.shell_failed_to_run.en: Result body of a background command that failed to execute.
task.shell_failed_to_run.zh: 后台命令执行失败时的结果正文。

task.shell_timeout_backgrounded.en: Receipt for a foreground command that timed out and keeps running in the background instead of being stopped.
task.shell_timeout_backgrounded.zh: 前台命令超时后未被终止、而转入后台继续运行时的回执。

task.shell_timeout_backgrounded_file.en: Same timeout receipt, used when the command's output is being written to a file.
task.shell_timeout_backgrounded_file.zh: 同一份超时回执，用于命令输出正写入文件的情况。

task.shell_background_receipt.en: Receipt for a command started with `run_in_background`: its task address and output file.
task.shell_background_receipt.zh: 以 `run_in_background` 启动命令时的回执，含任务地址和输出文件。

task.shell_output_file.en: Line naming the output file of a running background command, in `task_wait` timeouts and `task_list` rows.
task.shell_output_file.zh: 指出运行中后台命令输出文件的一行，出现在 `task_wait` 超时和 `task_list` 行中。

task.shell_output_file_earlier_lost.en: First line of an output file when the command's earliest output was dropped before it went to the background.
task.shell_output_file_earlier_lost.zh: 命令转入后台前最早的输出已被丢弃时，输出文件的第一行。

size.en: the amount of output that was not kept

task.shell_output_file_limit.en: Last line of a command's output file once it has reached its size limit.
task.shell_output_file_limit.zh: 命令输出文件达到大小上限后的最后一行。

task.stop_stopped.en: Result of a `task_stop` call that stopped a task, naming the task and what it was running.
task.stop_stopped.zh: `task_stop` 成功停止任务后的结果，说明任务及其正在运行的内容。

task.output_truncated.en: Suffix appended when a task's result was cut to the output limit.
task.output_truncated.zh: 任务结果被截断到输出上限时追加的后缀。

task.stopped_by_user.en: Sentence appended to a task's result when the user closed that task from the sidebar.
task.stopped_by_user.zh: 用户在侧边栏关闭任务时，追加到该任务结果后的一句话。

task.stopped_by_model.en: Sentence appended to a task's result when the model stopped that task with `task_stop`.
task.stopped_by_model.zh: 模型用 `task_stop` 停止任务时，追加到该任务结果后的一句话。

task.box_no_op.en: Tool result when the model itself calls `box`, which is Mewrk's message carrier and does nothing.
task.box_no_op.zh: 模型自己调用 `box` 时的工具结果；`box` 是 Mewrk 的消息载体，调用无效果。

task.notification.completed.en: Summary line of the notification sent when a background task completed.
task.notification.completed.zh: 后台任务完成时通知中的摘要行。

task.notification.failed.en: Summary line of the notification sent when a background task failed.
task.notification.failed.zh: 后台任务失败时通知中的摘要行。

task.notification.round_limit.en: Summary line of the notification sent when a background task stopped at its round limit.
task.notification.round_limit.zh: 后台任务达到回合上限而停止时通知中的摘要行。

task.notification.interrupted.en: Summary line of the notification sent when a background task was interrupted.
task.notification.interrupted.zh: 后台任务被中断时通知中的摘要行。

task.notification.stopped.en: Summary line of the notification sent when a background task was stopped.
task.notification.stopped.zh: 后台任务被停止时通知中的摘要行。

task.restart_summary.en: Summary of the notification sent when an app exit lost a subagent before its result reached the model.
task.restart_summary.zh: 应用退出导致子代理在结果送达模型前丢失时，通知中的摘要行。

task.restart_notice.en: Body of the notification sent when an app exit lost a subagent before its result reached the model.
task.restart_notice.zh: 应用退出导致子代理在结果送达模型前丢失时，通知的正文。

last_output.en: the last-text or no-text wording below
last_output.zh: 最后文字或无文字的说明

task.restart_last_output.en: Wording that quotes the lost subagent's last text, used in the lost-subagent notification.
task.restart_last_output.zh: 丢失子代理通知中引用其最后一段文字的措辞。

text.en: the last text the subagent wrote
text.zh: 子代理最后写下的文字

task.restart_no_output.en: Wording used in the lost-subagent notification when the subagent had written no text.
task.restart_no_output.zh: 丢失子代理通知中，子代理尚未写出任何文字时的措辞。

fork.request_submitted.en: Tool result of `fork` when the request was raised for the user to decide.
fork.request_submitted.zh: `fork` 请求已提交给用户决定时，该工具返回的结果。

handoff.armed_notice.en: Instruction to write handoff notes and call `handoff`, given when the context crosses the auto-compact threshold.
handoff.armed_notice.zh: 上下文越过自动压缩阈值时，指示模型写交接文档并调用 `handoff` 的提示。

handoff.index_context.en: Index of the handoff notes a continuation inherits, shown to the model when the continued conversation starts.
handoff.index_context.zh: 接续对话继承的交接文档索引，在对话开始时提供给模型。

notes.en: one line per note: its name and description
notes.zh: 每份交接文档一行：名称与说明

handoff.start_message.en: First user message Mewrk sends in a continuation conversation, telling it what to do first.
handoff.start_message.zh: Mewrk 在接续对话中发送的第一条用户消息，说明首次运行要做什么。

handoff.note_created.en: Tool result of a successful `create_handoff_note` call.
handoff.note_created.zh: `create_handoff_note` 调用成功后的工具结果。

handoff.note_updated.en: Tool result of a successful `edit_handoff_note` call.
handoff.note_updated.zh: `edit_handoff_note` 调用成功后的工具结果。

handoff.completed.en: Tool result of a successful `handoff` call, confirming the work moves to a continuation.
handoff.completed.zh: `handoff` 调用成功后的工具结果，说明工作已交接给接续对话。

host_notice.output_truncated.en: Host message sent when a response was cut off at the output limit, telling the model to continue.
host_notice.output_truncated.zh: 回复被输出长度上限截断时发送的宿主消息，要求模型接着写。

host_notice.hook_context.en: Host message carrying the extra context (`additionalContext`) that a hook added.
host_notice.hook_context.zh: 携带钩子附加的额外上下文（`additionalContext`）的宿主消息。

host_notice.mcp_unavailable.en: Host message sent at the start of a turn when selected MCP servers could not be used.
host_notice.mcp_unavailable.zh: 回合开始时，所选 MCP 服务器无法使用的宿主消息。

servers.en: one line per server with the reason it is unusable
servers.zh: 每台服务器一行，含不可用原因

host_notice.instruction_skips.en: Host message listing the instruction files (MEWRK.md, rules, imports) that a run left out.
host_notice.instruction_skips.zh: 列出本次运行未读取的指令文件（MEWRK.md、规则、导入）的宿主消息。

files.en: one line per skipped file, with the reason
files.zh: 每个被跳过的文件一行，含原因

instruction_skip.too_large.en: Reason listed for an instruction file skipped because it is larger than one instruction file may be.
instruction_skip.too_large.zh: 指令文件因超过单个文件大小上限而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.over_total_size.en: Reason listed for an instruction file skipped because it would exceed the combined size limit of all instruction files.
instruction_skip.over_total_size.zh: 指令文件因会超出全部指令文件总大小上限而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.over_file_count.en: Line of its own, naming no file, saying the run already reads as many instruction files as it may.
instruction_skip.over_file_count.zh: 单独一行（不指明文件），说明本次运行已读取到指令文件数量上限。

instruction_skip.not_utf8.en: Reason listed for an instruction file skipped because it is not valid UTF-8 text.
instruction_skip.not_utf8.zh: 指令文件因不是有效的 UTF-8 文本而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.secret.en: Reason listed for an instruction file skipped because it looks like it contains a credential or other secret.
instruction_skip.secret.zh: 指令文件因疑似含有凭据或其他机密而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.import_missing.en: Reason listed when an instruction file imports a file that does not exist or is not a file.
instruction_skip.import_missing.zh: 指令文件导入了不存在或不是文件的路径而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.import_unsupported.en: Reason listed for an import Mewrk does not follow: a URL or `~` path, a cycle, or one nested too deep.
instruction_skip.import_unsupported.zh: 导入项因 Mewrk 不支持（URL 或 `~` 路径、循环、嵌套过深）而被跳过时列出的原因。

instruction_skip.unreadable.en: Reason listed for an instruction file skipped because it could not be read.
instruction_skip.unreadable.zh: 指令文件因无法读取而被跳过时列出的原因。

host_notice.preview_start_failed.en: Host message sent when a dev server the user started from the preview pane failed to start.
host_notice.preview_start_failed.zh: 用户在预览窗格中启动的开发服务器启动失败时发送的宿主消息。

error.en: the error the failed start gave
error.zh: 启动失败给出的错误信息

web.executor_system_prompt.en: System prompt of the isolated executor that runs a provider-native `web_search`.
web.executor_system_prompt.zh: 运行提供商原生 `web_search` 的独立执行器的系统提示词。

budget_line.en: the line stating the search limit
budget_line.zh: 说明搜索次数限制的一行

web.executor_budget_unlimited.en: Search-budget line used in that system prompt when the conversation sets no search cap.
web.executor_budget_unlimited.zh: 对话未设搜索次数上限时，用在该系统提示词里的搜索预算行。

web.executor_budget_limited.en: Search-budget line used in that system prompt when the conversation caps searches per call.
web.executor_budget_limited.zh: 对话限制每次调用的搜索次数时，用在该系统提示词里的搜索预算行。

max_searches.en: the maximum number of searches per call
max_searches.zh: 每次调用的最大搜索次数

web.executor_task.en: User message given to the isolated web-search executor.
web.executor_task.zh: 交给独立网页搜索执行器的用户消息。

web.fetch_executor_system_prompt.en: System prompt of the isolated executor that runs a provider-native `web_fetch`.
web.fetch_executor_system_prompt.zh: 运行提供商原生 `web_fetch` 的独立执行器的系统提示词。

web.fetch_executor_task.en: User message given to the isolated web-fetch executor, carrying the URLs to retrieve.
web.fetch_executor_task.zh: 交给独立网页获取执行器的用户消息，附带要获取的网址。

urls.en: the URLs to fetch, one per line
urls.zh: 要获取的网址，每行一个

web.search_warnings.en: Line appended to native web-search findings when the provider reported search failures.
web.search_warnings.zh: 提供商报告搜索故障时，追加在原生网页搜索结果后的一行。

warnings.en: the search failures the provider reported
warnings.zh: 提供商报告的搜索故障

web.findings_notice.en: `notice` field of a native `web_search` result; empty by default (field omitted), fill it to flag findings as untrusted.
web.findings_notice.zh: 原生 `web_search` 结果中的 `notice` 字段，默认为空（不输出该字段）；填写后可标注结果不可信。

web.results_notice.en: `notice` field of a catalog-provider `web_search` or `web_fetch` result; empty by default (omitted), fill it to flag results as untrusted.
web.results_notice.zh: 目录提供商 `web_search` 或 `web_fetch` 结果的 `notice` 字段，默认为空（不输出）；填写后可标注不可信。

web.untrusted_marker.en: Prefix put before a retrieved line that looks like an instruction; empty by default, so such lines pass unmarked.
web.untrusted_marker.zh: 加在疑似指令的检索行前面的前缀，默认为空，即这类行不加标记直接放行。

memory.context_intro.en: First line inside the `<mewrk-memory>` block that carries each enabled tier's MEMORY.md.
memory.context_intro.zh: `<mewrk-memory>` 块中的第一行，该块包含各已启用层级的 MEMORY.md。

memory.tier.global.en: Name of the global memory tier.

memory.tier.project.en: Name of the project memory tier.

memory.tier.project_of_workspace.en: Name of one workspace's project memory when the conversation has several workspaces; it heads that workspace's index.
memory.tier.project_of_workspace.zh: 对话有多个工作区时，某个工作区的项目记忆名称，作为该工作区索引的标题。

memory.index_heading.en: Heading above a tier's MEMORY.md inside the memory block.
memory.index_heading.zh: 记忆块中位于某层级 MEMORY.md 上方的标题。

memory.created.en: Tool result of a successful `create_*_memory` call.
memory.created.zh: `create_*_memory` 调用成功后的工具结果。

memory.updated.en: Tool result of a successful `edit_*_memory` call.
memory.updated.zh: `edit_*_memory` 调用成功后的工具结果。

project_memory.untrusted_banner.en: Banner inside the project-instructions block warning that the file-authored instructions are untrusted.
project_memory.untrusted_banner.zh: 项目指令块内的警示横幅，说明文件中写的指令不可信。

hook.session_start_blocked.en: Assistant text written when a SessionStart hook blocked the turn.
hook.session_start_blocked.zh: SessionStart 钩子阻止回合时写出的助手文本。

hook.user_prompt_blocked.en: Assistant text written when a UserPromptSubmit hook blocked the turn.
hook.user_prompt_blocked.zh: UserPromptSubmit 钩子阻止回合时写出的助手文本。

hook.blocked_by.en: Reason given to the model when a hook denied a tool call without giving a reason of its own.
hook.blocked_by.zh: 钩子拒绝工具调用却没给出原因时，告知模型的原因。

hook.continue_fallback.en: User context injected when a Stop hook asks to continue but gives no reason.
hook.continue_fallback.zh: Stop 钩子要求继续却没给出原因时，注入的用户上下文。

hook.stop_limit_reached.en: Assistant text written when a Stop hook asked to continue too many times in a row.
hook.stop_limit_reached.zh: Stop 钩子连续要求继续的次数过多时写出的助手文本。

hook.stop_skipped_definition_revoked.en: Assistant text written when the Stop hook was skipped because the named agent's definition was revoked.
hook.stop_skipped_definition_revoked.zh: 指定代理的定义被撤销，导致 Stop 钩子被跳过时写出的助手文本。

hook.post_tool_not_rolled_back.en: Tool result substituted when a PostToolUse hook rejects a call whose effects cannot be rolled back.
hook.post_tool_not_rolled_back.zh: PostToolUse 钩子拒绝一次无法回滚的调用时，替换为该调用的工具结果。

hook.interrupted_call_skipped.en: Tool result of a call that was not executed because a hook interrupted the turn.
hook.interrupted_call_skipped.zh: 因钩子中断回合而未执行的工具调用所返回的工具结果。

mcp.mandatory_description_prefix.en: Prefix added to the description of an MCP tool that requires user approval on every call.
mcp.mandatory_description_prefix.zh: 加在每次调用都需用户批准的 MCP 工具描述前面的前缀。

run.no_text_reply.en: Assistant text written when the model ended a turn without any text.
run.no_text_reply.zh: 模型结束回合却没有输出任何文本时写出的助手文本。

workflow.not_recoverable.en: Line appended to a workflow receipt when its run directory could not be created.
workflow.not_recoverable.zh: 工作流运行目录创建失败时，追加在工作流回执后的一行。

workflow.aborted_cancelled.en: Result of a workflow run that was cancelled or whose turn ended.
workflow.aborted_cancelled.zh: 工作流运行被取消或所在回合结束时的结果。

workflow.aborted_channel.en: Result of a workflow run aborted by a Mewrk event-channel failure.
workflow.aborted_channel.zh: 工作流运行因 Mewrk 事件通道故障而中止时的结果。

workflow.resume_hint.en: Line appended to a failed workflow result, explaining how to resume the run.
workflow.resume_hint.zh: 追加在失败的工作流结果后的一行，说明如何恢复该运行。

workflow.resume_degraded.en: Resume hint used instead when journal writes failed, so a resume replays nothing.
workflow.resume_degraded.zh: 日志写入失败、恢复时无法复用任何步骤时改用的恢复提示。

workflow.resume_repeated_warning.en: Line appended to a resume hint when steps kept starting without ever finishing.
workflow.resume_repeated_warning.zh: 有步骤反复启动却始终没有结果时，追加在恢复提示后的一行。

workflow.losers_cancelled.en: Progress note written when the workflow script returned while steps were still running.
workflow.losers_cancelled.zh: 工作流脚本返回结果时仍有步骤在运行，据此写出的进度说明。

count.en: the number of steps still running

workflow.step_no_structured.en: Error of a workflow step that finished without returning its required structured result.
workflow.step_no_structured.zh: 工作流步骤结束时没有返回要求的结构化结果，所报的错误。

workflow.step_ended_with.en: Error of a workflow step that ended in a status other than completed.
workflow.step_ended_with.zh: 工作流步骤以非已完成状态结束时所报的错误。

workflow.step_preview_truncated.en: Suffix marking a step's output preview as truncated in the workflow timeline context.
workflow.step_preview_truncated.zh: 工作流时间线上下文中，标明步骤输出预览已被截断的后缀。

workflow.step_no_result.en: Error shown for a workflow step that finished without producing any result.
workflow.step_no_result.zh: 工作流步骤没有产生任何结果时显示的错误。

workflow.step_not_started.en: Error shown for a workflow step that had not started yet when the run was aborted.
workflow.step_not_started.zh: 运行被中止时尚未开始的工作流步骤所显示的错误。

workflow.restart_summary.en: Summary line of the notification sent when an application restart interrupted a workflow run.
workflow.restart_summary.zh: 应用重启打断工作流运行时，所发通知的摘要行。

task.zh: 工作流对应的后台任务

workflow.restart_notice.en: Body of the notification sent when a restart interrupted a workflow run that Mewrk could not resume.
workflow.restart_notice.zh: 应用重启打断工作流运行且 Mewrk 无法恢复时，通知的正文。

task.zh: 工作流对应的后台任务

reusable_steps.en: number of reusable journaled step results
reusable_steps.zh: 可复用的步骤结果数量

reason.en: why Mewrk could not resume it

workflow.restart_resumed_summary.en: Summary line of the notification sent when Mewrk resumed a workflow run that a restart had interrupted.
workflow.restart_resumed_summary.zh: Mewrk 恢复被应用重启打断的工作流运行时，所发通知的摘要行。

task.zh: 工作流对应的后台任务

workflow.restart_resumed.en: Body of the notification sent when Mewrk resumed a workflow run that a restart had interrupted.
workflow.restart_resumed.zh: Mewrk 恢复被应用重启打断的工作流运行时，所发通知的正文。

task.zh: 工作流对应的后台任务

reusable_steps.en: number of reusable journaled step results
reusable_steps.zh: 可复用的步骤结果数量

tool.ls_limit.en: Line ending an `ls` result cut by the character budget, saying down to which depth the listing is complete.
tool.ls_limit.zh: `ls` 结果被字符预算截断时的提示行，说明列表完整到第几层。

depth.en: depth to which the listing is complete

tool.ls_limit_partial.en: Line ending an `ls` result cut by the character budget partway through the first level.
tool.ls_limit_partial.zh: `ls` 结果在第一层中途被字符预算截断时的提示行。

tool.ls_ignored_note.en: Line of an `ls` result explaining that ignored directories are listed but not expanded.
tool.ls_ignored_note.zh: `ls` 结果中说明被忽略的目录只列出、不展开的提示行。

tool.ignored_entry.en: An ignored entry in an `ls` or `find` result, such as a directory `ls` did not expand.
tool.ignored_entry.zh: `ls` 或 `find` 结果中被忽略的条目，如 `ls` 未展开的目录。

tool.grep_skipped.en: Line in a `grep` or `ls` result for an entry that could not be read.
tool.grep_skipped.zh: `grep` 或 `ls` 结果中无法读取的条目所占的一行。

tool.grep_limit.en: Last line of a `grep` page when more matches follow, giving the offset of the next page.
tool.grep_limit.zh: `grep` 结果页末尾的提示行：还有更多匹配，并给出下一页的偏移量。

from.en: number of the first match shown
from.zh: 本页第一个匹配的序号

to.en: number of the last match shown
to.zh: 本页最后一个匹配的序号

tool.grep_no_match.zh: `grep` 没有匹配时的返回结果。

tool.grep_no_match_at_offset.en: `grep` result when the requested offset is past the last match.
tool.grep_no_match_at_offset.zh: `grep` 所请求的偏移量超出最后一个匹配时的返回结果。

tool.grep_count_total.en: Last line of a `grep` result in `count` mode, totalling the whole search rather than just the page.
tool.grep_count_total.zh: `grep` 在 `count` 模式下结果末尾的总计行，统计整次搜索而非当前页。

tool.grep_context_unavailable.en: Note on a remote `grep` result that left out requested context lines because that machine's grep cannot print them.
tool.grep_context_unavailable.zh: 远程 `grep` 结果中的提示：该机器的 grep 无法清晰输出上下文行，故已省略。

tool.find_limit.en: Line of a `find` result that returned only some of its matches.
tool.find_limit.zh: `find` 结果只返回了部分匹配时的提示行。

tool.find_ignored_note.en: Line of a `find` result saying some matches are in ignored paths and are listed last.
tool.find_ignored_note.zh: `find` 结果中说明部分匹配位于被忽略路径、并排在最后的提示行。

count.en: number of matches in ignored paths
count.zh: 位于被忽略路径的匹配数

tool.find_scan_limit.en: Line of a `find` result that stopped examining entries, so the shown total is only a lower bound.
tool.find_scan_limit.zh: `find` 在检查条目数达上限后停止、总数仅为下限时的提示行。

tool.find_no_match.zh: `find` 没有匹配时的返回结果。

tool.read_image.en: `read` result for an image file; the image itself is attached.
tool.read_image.zh: `read` 读取图片文件时的结果，图片本身随附在结果中。

tool.read_empty_file.en: `read` result for a file with no content.

tool.read_range_out_of_bounds.en: `read` result when the requested start line is past the end of the file.
tool.read_range_out_of_bounds.zh: `read` 所请求的起始行超出文件末尾时的返回结果。

tool.read_limit.en: Last line of a `read` result that stopped before the end of the file or the requested range.
tool.read_limit.zh: `read` 结果在文件或请求范围结束前停止时的末尾提示行。

tool.read_limit_uncounted.en: Last line of a `read` result that stopped early in a file too large to count the lines of.
tool.read_limit_uncounted.zh: `read` 在过大而未统计行数的文件中提前停止时的末尾提示行。

tool.read_line_truncated.en: Marker ending a `read` line that was cut because the line alone exceeds what one read can return.
tool.read_line_truncated.zh: `read` 中因单行过长超出单次读取上限而被截断的行末标记。

tool.read_lossy_note.en: Last line of a `read` result decoded lossily because the file is not valid UTF-8.
tool.read_lossy_note.zh: `read` 结果末尾的提示行：文件不是有效的 UTF-8，已有损解码。

tool.read_utf16_note.en: Last line of a `read` result decoded from UTF-16, which `edit` cannot modify.
tool.read_utf16_note.zh: `read` 结果末尾的提示行：文件为 UTF-16 并已解码，`edit` 无法修改。

tool.read_binary.en: `read` error for a file that holds binary data rather than text.
tool.read_binary.zh: `read` 遇到二进制文件而非文本时的错误。

tool.write_done.en: `write` result, a bare acknowledgement by default; you may use the values to name the file.
tool.write_done.zh: `write` 的返回结果，默认只是简单确认；可借助占位符点明文件。

bytes.en: the byte count of the write

tool.edit_done.en: `edit` result, a bare acknowledgement by default; you may use the path to name the file.
tool.edit_done.zh: `edit` 的返回结果，默认只是简单确认；可借助占位符点明文件。

tool.edit_done_all.en: `edit` result with replace_all, saying how many occurrences were replaced; the default omits the file.
tool.edit_done_all.zh: `edit` 使用 replace_all 时的结果，说明替换了多少处；默认不含文件名。

tool.file_state_current.en: Suffix on a `write`/`edit` result while file write guards are on, telling the model it need not read the file back.
tool.file_state_current.zh: 文件写入保护开启时，附在 `write`/`edit` 结果后的后缀，告知模型无需回读文件。

tool.edit_stale_recovered.en: Suffix on an `edit` result applied to a file that changed since the model read it, as the find text still matched.
tool.edit_stale_recovered.zh: `edit` 作用于读取后已被改动的文件、且查找文本仍能匹配时，附在结果后的后缀。

tool.file_changed_notice.en: Notice at turn start that a file the model read has since changed on disk, with the changed regions numbered.
tool.file_changed_notice.zh: 回合开始时的通知：模型读过的文件已在磁盘上变化，并附带带行号的变更片段。

snippet.en: the changed regions with line numbers

tool.file_changed_omitted.en: The same notice when earlier files in the turn already used up the snippet budget, so the diff is omitted.
tool.file_changed_omitted.zh: 同一通知的省略版：本回合前面的文件已用完片段额度，故不附变更内容。

tool.hook_file_resynced.en: Notice that a PostToolUse hook rewrote the file `write`/`edit` just wrote, and Mewrk re-read it.
tool.hook_file_resynced.zh: PostToolUse 钩子改写了 `write`/`edit` 刚写入的文件，Mewrk 已重新读取时的通知。

tool.shell_stale_read_hint.en: Suffix on a shell result when a formatter-like command changed files the model had read.
tool.shell_stale_read_hint.zh: 类似格式化工具的命令改动了模型读过的文件时，附在 shell 结果后的后缀。

tool.shell_stale_read_more.en: Tail of the file list in that hint when more than five files changed.
tool.shell_stale_read_more.zh: 上述提示中改动文件超过五个时，附在文件列表末尾的省略说明。

tool.shell_cwd_outside_workspace.en: Suffix on a successful shell result whose command ended outside its workspace; the next command starts at the root.
tool.shell_cwd_outside_workspace.zh: shell 命令成功但结束在工作区外时的结果后缀，下条命令将从工作区根目录开始。

directory.en: the directory the command ended in

tool.shell_output_omitted.en: Line standing in for the middle of a command's output, beyond what is kept of its start and end.
tool.shell_output_omitted.zh: 命令输出中间部分被省略后，用来代替它的占位行（仅保留开头和结尾）。

tool.shell_user_aborted.en: Shell result when the user aborted the command.
tool.shell_user_aborted.zh: 用户中止命令时的 shell 结果。

tool.shell_exit_unknown.en: Stands in for the exit code when the process reported none.
tool.shell_exit_unknown.zh: 进程未返回退出码时，用来代替退出码的文字。

tool.shell_completed.en: Status line of a finished shell command that printed nothing.
tool.shell_completed.zh: shell 命令执行完毕且没有任何输出时的状态行。

tool.shell_exit_code.en: Leading line of a failed shell result, placed before its stderr and stdout.
tool.shell_exit_code.zh: 失败的 shell 结果的首行，位于 stderr 和 stdout 之前。

tool.shell_timed_out.en: Shell result when the deadline expired and the command, which could not be moved to the background, was stopped.
tool.shell_timed_out.zh: 超时后命令无法转入后台而被停止时的 shell 结果。

tool.output_truncated.en: Suffix added when a tool result was cut to the output limit.
tool.output_truncated.zh: 工具结果被截断到输出上限时附加的后缀。

tool.output_spilled.en: What a shell or `grep` result too long to return whole becomes: where the full output was saved, plus its start.
tool.output_spilled.zh: 过长的 shell 或 `grep` 结果的替代内容：完整输出的保存位置及开头预览。

path.en: the file the full output was saved to

tool.diff_truncated.en: Suffix added when a `write`/`edit` diff was cut to the limit.
tool.diff_truncated.zh: `write`/`edit` 的差异被截断到上限时附加的后缀。

format.list_separator.en: Separator Mewrk puts between names it joins into a list, such as hook names, task addresses and status roll-ups.
format.list_separator.zh: Mewrk 把名称连成列表（如钩子名称、任务地址、状态汇总）时使用的分隔符。
